title: Muslim Ke sar ko zalim dar dar
body:
MUSLIM ASWS. KE SAR KO ZALIM DAR DAR PHIRAA RAHE HAIN.
MARQAD MEIN SAYYADA S.A. KO YUN BHI RULAA RAHE HAIN.
1. ALLAH RE MUSLIM ASWS. KA KOI NAHI THA MOHSIN.
ZILHIJJA KI NAWI THI AUR ARFE KA THA WO DIN.
GHURBAT MEIN BEQATA KO AADA L.A. SATAA RAHE HAIN.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. EID E ZOHA KA TUJHKO KUCH TO LIHAAZ HOTA.
HAAYE AHLEBAIT PAR TU AISE ZULAM NA DHAATA.
YASRAB MEIN MUSTAFA SAWW. BHI AANSOO BAHAA RAHE HAIN.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. MUSLIM ASWS. KE LAAL DONO DAR DAR BHATAK RAHE HAIN.
ROTE HUE WO BEKAS BABA KO TAK RAHE HAIN.
SEHME HUE HAI BACHE MAA KO BULAA RAHE HAIN..
<<DIVIDER>>
4. QANJAR KO YUN CHAMKAAYE AAYA QAREEB E MUSLIM ASWS.
KEHNE LAGE TADAP KE US DAM YEH HAAYE MUSLIM.
BEJURM BEQATA KO AADA L.A. RULAA RAHE HAIN.
Kalaam: JANAB SYED MOHEBBE ABID ABIDI SAHAB QIBLA.
